author: Bobby Grayson
description: STATUS: fixtures 25 -> 26 (22 ok, 4 error); remeasure lines/theorems (by grep ^theorem: main 274 -> branch 307; hand-written Lean 4,924 -> about 5,323 lines; SysProps 1,079 -> 1,373; SupervisorProof 290 -> 315; WatchdogProof 287 -> 361; TaskProof unchanged 313). LAYOUT ROW Sys.lean: append "; an untrappable kill signal terminates even a trapping target and its links see error". LAYOUT ROW SysProps.lean: append ", where signals and actors come from (applyEffects_mem_signals_cases, Effect.init? and the _stateOf_spawn_cases lemmas), the NoKillTo predicate". PARAGRAPH "One output shape": replace "maps any non-:normal reason to error" with "maps :normal to normal, :kill to kill and any other reason to error". PARAGRAPH "Timers and remote exits": replace "Process.exit(p, reason) queues an exit signal to p." with "Process.exit(p, reason) queues an exit signal to p with exactly the BEAM meaning: a kill signal terminates p whether or not it traps, and the EXIT and DOWN notifications p own links and monitors then receive carry error (the BEAM :killed); a normal signal from another process is ignored by a non-trapping p and delivered as {:EXIT, from, :normal} to a trapping one; an error signal is delivered to a trapping p and kills a non-trapping one. A process exiting itself ({:stop, r, s}, exit/1, raise) notifies its links with r, where kill is reported as error. The watchdog kills its worker with Process.exit(w, :kill), translated to .signal w .kill." PARAGRAPH "Sys metatheory": append "Round 3 added Reason.propagated and the kill case: signalE_cases is five-way, signalE_stateOf says a target dies only of a non-normal signal, and three new groups of lemmas: applyEffects_mem_signals_cases (every signal is old, a noproc error, or one of the step own signal effects), Effect.init? with applyEffects_stateOf_cases / runE_stateOf_spawn_cases / SysStep.stateOf_spawn_cases (every actor after a step is unchanged, dead, the actor that ran, or spawned in the initial state of one of that step effects; no q < next bound), and Sys.NoKillTo p (no pending kill is addressed to p) with NoKillTo.runE / signalE / downE / timerE and SysStep.noKillTo." PARAGRAPH "The Sys proofs on SysProps": append "Since a kill would terminate the trapping supervisor or watchdog, their Inv.signal and Inv.step take NoKillTo 0 as an extra hypothesis and reach_inv inducts on Inv together with it (the supervisor: no clause signals at all, beh_no_signal; the watchdog: its only signal is the kill to its own worker, which is never pid 0 because every worker is spawned at a fresh positive pid, the ChildNe invariant carried through SysStep.stateOf_spawn_cases). Every named theorem keeps its statement. Checker counts did not move: 236,220 / 40, 10,411 / 749, 243,526." PARAGRAPH "Spawn, links and exits are a layer": replace "either as a message to a trapping target or by terminating a non-trapping one, which queues more signals" with "as a message to a trapping target, by ignoring a normal one or terminating a non-trapping one on error, or by terminating the target regardless on kill, which queues more (error) signals". PARAGRAPH "Translator fixtures": "25 small sources" -> "26 small sources" and in the feature list replace "Process.exit" with "Process.exit with :kill, :normal and other reasons, self-exits with :kill". SECTION "Not modelled yet": delete ":kill as untrappable,". BUILD block: "25 translator fixtures" -> "26".
